description:
Migrate the seven M4RM schedule fields to runtime resolved reads reaching choose_k_block and use_register_tiled_schedule.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.3 and the m4rm row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The seven m4rm fields are runtime resolved reads reaching choose_k_block and use_register_tiled_schedule once per multiplication, satisfying design §2.3, with the tiled_min_stride_words floor citing M4RM_TILE_WORDS.
- [hard] REQ-02: m4rm_schedule_route reports tier and panel width, the dispatcher calls it, tier-boundary route files pass, and the retained legacy-schedule comparison still runs on the conservative table.
- [hard] REQ-03: The rustdoc sweep across the m4rm constant block states default-definition roles and profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the M4RM schedule selectors over to the tuning profile
